reason: The README clearly describes a cited session-memory plugin that distills durable facts, recalls them through prompt indexing and tools, and manages local memory files.

summaries.zh: 一个将会话内容提炼为带原始日志引用的可审计记忆，并提供检索、展开及本地管理功能的 DSH 插件。
summaries.en: A DSH plugin that distills sessions into auditable memories with source citations and provides tools and CLI commands to recall and manage them.

capabilities: Distills session transcripts into durable memory files
Stores citations linking memories to exact session-log ranges
Injects a compact memory index into prompt assembly
Provides tools to read memories and expand cited session excerpts
Provides CLI and slash-command operations to list, edit, show, and delete memories
Uses the configured language-model provider for post-session distillation
